lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man naam hiradai dhaar ||
lines.translation: O my mind, enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar preet man tan laai har siu avar sagal visaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Love the Lord, and commit your mind and body to Him; forget everything else. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu man tan praan prabh ke too aapan aap nivaar ||
lines.translation: Soul, mind, body and breath of life belong to God; eliminate your self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: govid bhaj sabh suaarath poore naanak kabahu na haar ||2||4||27||
lines.translation: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and all your desires shall be fulfilled; O Nanak, you shall never be defeated. ||2||4||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਤਾਪੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਥੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj aap binasee taap ren saadhoo theeu ||
lines.translation: Renounce your self-conceit, and the fever shall depart; become the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi paraapat naam teraa kar kripaa jis deeu ||1||
lines.translation: He alone receives Your Name, Lord, whom You bless with Your Mercy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man naam a(n)mrit peeu ||
lines.translation: O my mind, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan saad bisaar hochhe amar jug jug jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Abandon other bland, insipid tastes; become immortal, and live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam ik ras ra(n)g naamaa naam laagee leeu ||
lines.translation: Savor the essence of the One and only Naam; love the Naam, focus and attune yourself to the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਉ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa ba(n)dhap har ek naanak keeu ||2||5||28||
lines.translation: Nanak has made the One Lord his only friend, companion and relative. ||2||5||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਗਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਸੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaal maataa udar raakhai lagan det na sek ||
lines.translation: He nourishes and preserves mortals in the womb of the mother, so that the fiery heat does not hurt them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਈਹਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਬੂਝੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: soee suaamee eehaa raakhai boojh budh bibek ||1||
lines.translation: That Lord and Master protects us here. Understand this in your mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man naam kee kar tek ||
lines.translation: O my mind, take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੂਝੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi boojh jin too keeaa prabh karan kaaran ek ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Understand the One who created you; the One God is the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭੇਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: chet man mahi taj siaanap chhod sagale bhekh ||
lines.translation: Remember the One Lord in your mind, renounce your clever tricks, and give up all your religious robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਕਈ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: simar har har sadaa naanak tare kaee anek ||2||6||29||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, countless beings have been saved. ||2||6||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan naam jaa ko anaath ko hai naath ||
lines.translation: His Name is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Master of the masterless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੁਲਹੋ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bhaujal maahi tulaho jaa ko likhio maath ||1||
lines.translation: In the vast and terrifying world-ocean, he is the raft for those who have such destiny inscribed on their foreheads. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੂਬੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: doobe naam bin ghan saath ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, huge numbers of companions have drowned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran chit na aavai de kar raakhai haath ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Even if someone does not remember the Lord, the Cause of causes, still, the Lord reaches out with His hand, and saves him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat gun uchaaran har naam a(n)mrit paath ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and take the Path of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਥ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa muraar maadhau sun naanak jeevai gaath ||2||7||30||
lines.translation: Shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord; listening to Your sermon, Nanak lives. ||2||7||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo a(n)julee mahalaa 5 ghar 7 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog dhurahu hee hooaa ||
lines.translation: Union and separation are ordained by the Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch dhaat kar putalaa keeaa ||
lines.translation: The puppet is made from the five elements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੈ ਕੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਅੜੈ ਜੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saahai kai phuramaaiaRai jee dehee vich jeeu aai paiaa ||1||
lines.translation: By the Command of the Dear Lord King, the soul came and entered into the body. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai agan bhakhai bhaRahaare ||
lines.translation: In that place, where the fire rages like an oven,

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooradh mukh mahaa gubaare ||
lines.translation: in that darkness where the body lies face down

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਓਥੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas samaale soee othai khasam chhadaai laiaa ||2||
lines.translation: - there, one remembers his Lord and Master with each and every breath, and then he is rescued. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਰਭੈ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu garabhai nikal aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Then, one comes out from within the womb,

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasam visaar dunee chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: and forgetting his Lord and Master, he attaches his consciousness to the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਕਿਤਹੀ ਥਾਇ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai jonee rahan na kitahee thaai bhaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: He comes and goes, and wanders in reincarnation; he cannot remain anywhere. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਰਖਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: miharavaan rakh laian aape ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself emancipates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh tis ke thaape ||
lines.translation: He created and established all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jin chaliaa naanak aaiaa so paravaan thiaa ||4||1||31||
lines.translation: Those who depart after having been victorious in this priceless human life - O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved. ||4||1||31||
